made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/cuenta-sheet-make.js, from cuenta-set.html (window.CUENTA.E) and the design of La cuenta (the orchestrator's p8-spec, section cuenta). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 66. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the back wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 66 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 1: the counter's top; z 0.44: a seat's top; z 0.8: the cart's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the cup, the flans, the tub, the machine and the jar have their bottom middle on the spot; the cover (tapa) hangs: its top middle on the spot (z .5, at the cart's right side); the cart has its bottom middle on the spot (its feet) and its top surface 18 px above that. scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty), 41 for a child; abuela standing (engine.js mkAbuela, 48 x 51): column 30 (her middle); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a grown-up or a child sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41; t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy); a small thing: see spot. Whoever sits at the table sits on the far side facing the camera: no sprite is turned (the makers draw them from the front)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.cart: the dessert cart is a sprite 76 x 22 with its feet (bottom middle) on carrito (carrito2 at the next table): its top surface is z 0.8, 18 px above its feet, so the things that stand on it have their spot at z 0.8 and their bottom edge on the cart's top surface (canvas row 4 of the sprite is the first row below them). The same five places at the next table are the first five shifted by (u -1.25, v +3.5)
rules.counter: things stand on the counter's top at z 1, v 1.2 to 1.3 (the top spans v 0.9 to 1.5); whoever serves stands behind it at v .45 and is hidden below the counter's far edge (and below the register) by the depth rule, as the set draws them
rules.waist: the spec says "whole from the waist up" and "whole from the chest up" without rows: the top 35 rows of a grown-up's sprite (27 of a child's) are the waist up, the top 29 (25) the chest up (a grown-up's hips are canvas rows 35 to 41, the torso's centre is row 29; the head is the top 14 rows)

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the counter, the register and the glass case hide whoever stands behind them from the counter's top down, the table hides the lower body of whoever sits at it.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El calendario's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn (the things on the cart, and the frog on it, are a tie with the cart: they are drawn after it)

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El calendario's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits at a table, stands on the counter or on the cart (z above 0) casts none: none of them is ground (a shadow cast at the floor under them would show in front of them)
